subject.title: feat(durable): add beta3 wake replay foundation

question: After the replay ownership defect is fixed, should the opt-in durable runtime stack—with persisted wake/replay state in the shared database—ship on the beta3 release line?
rationale: The implementation introduces a broad core runtime and stored-state contract, and the PR discussion explicitly inherits product and ownership approval from the still-open upstream stack; code correctness alone cannot decide release acceptance.

options.title: Sponsor beta3 durable runtime
options.body: Accept the core direction, require the claimant-fencing repair and upgrade proof, then review and land the dependent stack in order.

options.title: Defer this stack
options.body: Keep the durable runtime out of this release line and close or retarget the dependent PRs together.

recommendation.title: Sponsor beta3 durable runtime
recommendation.body: Accept the core direction, require the claimant-fencing repair and upgrade proof, then review and land the dependent stack in order.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history signal is recent ownership of the shared-state compatibility surface, which is central to this release-level product choice.
